def weighted_mean_pct_floor(values, weights):
    """Compute the weighted average of a batch of integer scores and report it
    as a scaled, floored integer. values and weights are non-empty lists of
    ints of the same length; every weight is strictly positive. Pair each
    score with its weight, add up the weighted contributions, then divide by
    the total weight, scaling by 100 before the floor is taken. Return the
    weighted mean scaled by 100 and floored, computed as (100 *
    sum(values[i] * weights[i] for all i)) // sum(weights), using integer
    floor division exactly as written.

    >>> weighted_mean_pct_floor([1], [1])
    100
    >>> weighted_mean_pct_floor([1, 3], [1, 1])
    200
    """
